context: Tests that Step 6 is automatic for full/assets-only flows once assets are searchable, so the agent does not miss collections or wait for another user prompt.

checklist.name: Does not stop after assets
checklist.description: The agent continues after confirming search/facet behavior instead of ending the turn as if assets alone complete the full demo.

checklist.name: Runs create-collections.js automatically
checklist.description: The agent invokes .claude/skills/customer-migration/scripts/assets/create-collections.js without requiring the user to ask separately.

checklist.name: Company-scoped collections only
checklist.description: The collections are stamped/scoped to the company and no global or uncategorized collection is created.

checklist.name: Marks done after visible verification
checklist.description: collections-created is marked done only after verifying the portal shows the new company collections with assets.

checklist.name: Plain language
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced to the customer.
